features.desc: Focus on the act of recording itself, while Chaerok's intelligent engine automates the rest.

f1.title: Rapid Capture
f1.desc: Capture any moment instantly. Just drop in text, links, or images and Chaerok keeps them safe.

f2.title: Intelligent Summary
f2.desc: Find the core within vast information. The AI agent transforms complex notes into intuitive briefings.

f3.title: Semantic Connection
f3.desc: Different thoughts meet to create new insights. The ontology-based graph UI visualizes the links between your ideas.

ontology.desc: Chaerok manages records not as a linear list, but as an organic web. As your thoughts grow, the knowledge graph becomes denser, suggesting new ideas you hadn't discovered before.

extension.desc: When you come across something worth keeping, save it without copying links around. Chaerok summarizes it and files it with tags.
extension.step2: Open chrome://extensions and turn on "Developer mode" in the top right.
extension.step3: Click "Load unpacked" and pick the unzipped folder.

f1.title: One click to save
f1.desc: Toolbar icon, right-click menu, or the Alt+Shift+C shortcut — whichever you reach for.

f2.title: Save just the part you picked
f2.desc: Select a passage first and only that gets saved. Select nothing and it finds the article body.

f3.title: Lands with everything else
f3.desc: Pages saved here stack up alongside what you save on your phone. With Chaerok Pro they open on any device.

pricing.title: Try Pro free for two weeks

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I use it for free?
faq.a1: The basics — capturing, organizing, and searching — are free forever and run on your device without an account. Long-context understanding, reading images, Chaerok's briefings and weekly report, and syncing across devices come with Chaerok Pro — and you can try all of it free for your first two weeks.
faq.a2: Your notes are stored on your device first. Sign in and turn on Chaerok Pro's cloud sync to back them up automatically and continue on other devices. However, bulk export features like Markdown or CSV formats are planned to be supported gradually.
faq.q3: Do you support languages other than Korean?
faq.a3: Currently, we fully support semantic analysis for Korean and English records, and we plan to gradually expand supported languages.
